messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: running 01_hello
parts:
If you want to create an app on glimmer (via the RStudio server interface), create them in ~/ShinyApps/<appname>, where ~ is your home directory and <appname> is whatever you want. Then you can view your app at:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/<username>/<appname>
where <username> is your username.

For example, this is an app on my account on glimmer:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/stocks/


The runExample() function is for use in an R session on your local computer. Same goes for runApp(). These functions will run a simple webserver on your computer on port 8100, and then open a browser pointing to localhost:8100.

One approach you could use is to do development on your local computer, and then once your app is functional, upload it to Glimmer.

-Winston
